description: Claude's finished turn asks the user to open a sign-in URL and paste back the verification code it gives, with the long OAuth URL wrapped across plain terminal rows. A live card showed this ask with only Reply: the parse listed the URL in links but left question.link unset, so the Needs-you card had nothing to click. Asserted: a typed question whose link is the WHOLE reassembled URL, also offered in links, so the card leads with Open link. Invented from scratch; host, client id and state values are fictional.
